summary: Implemented file-read progress tracking in rich/progress.py: a private _Reader class (read/readinto/readline/readlines/iteration/seek/close, advancing a Progress task by bytes read), Progress.read(file, total=None, task_id=None, description="Reading...") accepting a path or binary file-like object (total required for file-likes, taken from os.stat for paths), and a module-level rich.progress.read(...) that starts its own Progress and returns the reader. Added a CHANGELOG.md entry. Nothing was run or tested, per instructions, and nothing was committed. No tests were added; they can be added on request.
